raw_text: BREAKING: Barbados-flagged bulk carrier True Confidence hit by Houthi missile in Gulf of Aden. Multiple crew casualties confirmed including fatalities. This is the first time Houthi maritime attacks have killed crew members. The vessel was transiting without naval escort. Indian Navy ships in the area are responding.
